entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: actual 2D side-view brawler character animation sheet, transparent RGBA, one horizontal row of exactly SIX distinct full-body poses.
Primary request: Generate Mac Modem from the supplied canonical references as a slim, wiry man, never a bulky muscular action hero. This is a game sprite sheet, NOT a character poster or scene.
Input images: 1 exact canonical facial identity/paint; 2 canonical red outfit and slim body proportions; 3 corroborating thin body and two narrow braids; 4 polished detailed comic-ink style only, not its camera angle.
Identity: ginger beard and moustache; precisely two thin long ginger braids; black cap and black tee with the small red MODEM clothing mark; open burgundy sleeveless vest; narrow black trousers and red low-top sneakers with pale soles; tattooed slender arms, pendant. White painted face, fine red Wi-Fi/signal arcs across forehead, red eyes, fine asymmetric black circuit paint. Keep the same recognizable face and clothing in every pose.
Composition: wide 3:1 canvas, ideally 3072 x 1024. Six EQUAL invisible rectangular cells, each one sixth of width, centered at 1/12, 3/12, 5/12, 7/12, 9/12, 11/12. Leave at least 5% cell-width clear alpha margin at BOTH edges of EVERY cell. Character entirely contained in his own cell, including fists, hair and sneakers. No cell outlines. Orthographic SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT in every cell, with only slight chest visibility to preserve the tee. Same camera, silhouette proportions and pixel scale, no foreshortening and no tilted view.
Pose order strictly left to right: 1 idle ready stance arms relaxed; 2 walking contact pose left leg forward/right leg back; 3 walking opposite contact pose right leg forward/left leg back; 4 straight punch to the right, ONE lead fist extended horizontally and other fist guarding, plausible connected shoulder/elbow/wrist, no weapon; 5 compact guard with both fists in front of face; 6 jump silhouette with bent knees and arms balanced.
Registration: keep cap top and body scale consistent. For poses 1-5 set the lowest shoe sole to the same baseline at 92% canvas height. For pose 6 use the same cell anchor baseline, with the lowest shoe sole also at 92% so the GAME can lift the whole pose during the jump; bend knees by raising the other shoe, do not shrink the man. Preserve clean separation and padding for deterministic equal-cell cropping.
Style: sharp detailed hand-inked comic illustration, textured painted clothing and clean readable silhouettes, restrained amber/cyan edge highlights on the character only. No pixelation, no low-poly facets, no blurry areas.
Constraints: GENUINE transparent background with clean alpha. NO opaque color backdrop, fake checkerboard, ground shadow, platform or scenery. No separate portraits, no text labels or captions, no grid, no borders, no other characters, no extra arms or legs, no floating hands, no extra weapons, no motion streaks crossing cells, no watermark. Anatomy and hands must be plausible; six instances of the SAME slim Mac.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: corrected transparent 2D game sprite sheet.
Edit image1 only. Preserve the canonical slim Mac identity, clothing, detailed comic ink, tattoos, face paint and real transparent alpha. Images2-4 are the governing canonical face/slim outfit references. Do not bulk up the arms or torso.
Fix ONLY the animation-sheet framing/poses. Exactly six EQUAL cells in one horizontal row, no outlines/captions. Each cell is one sixth of total width. Full characters must never cross their cell boundaries; especially shorten the punch's stance and shift its arm within cell4. Maintain 10% completely clear transparent left and right padding inside every cell. Leave continuous transparent gutters between all six poses. Make all poses fit by drawing the standing character slightly shorter in the canvas (about 72% canvas height), with ample empty alpha above and below. Do not crop a sneaker or fist.
The six cells in order: idle; LEFT foot forward walking with RIGHT foot back; clearly opposite RIGHT foot forward walking with LEFT foot back; straight right-facing punch; both fists up guarding; jump pose with bent knees.
Camera is strict orthographic side/right-facing for all6, same body proportions, scale and outfit. Left/right walk contacts must visibly alternate the lead leg and arm, not duplicate the same stride.
Registration: for ALL six cells align the LOWEST SHOE SOLE exactly to the SAME horizontal line at 90% canvas height. Jump pose is a bent-knee pose located at this same crop anchor, not floating at the top of its cell; the game supplies the airborne vertical movement. Jump crouching lowers head height naturally, but do not change the man's actual body scale.
A clean straight punch: one slender arm extended right, opposite arm guarding, realistic fist/wrist; use compact feet so it fits its column. Plausible hands, no disconnected joints or duplicate limbs. Guard compact and relaxed, not a bodybuilder.
No scenery, ground shadows, solid background, checkerboard pixels, labels, borders, other characters, weapons or extra objects. The only lettering is Mac's existing MODEM clothing mark. Preserve genuine transparency and leave every gutter completely empty. Final row is six separately usable game poses with no overlap.

Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a production 2D game sprite sheet on genuine transparent alpha.
Exactly SIX SMALL full-body Mac Modem sprites in ONE horizontal row on a wide 3:1 canvas. Imagine SIX EQUAL invisible portrait columns. Center one pose in each column. CRITICAL: each standing man is only HALF THE HEIGHT of the whole canvas, so even a horizontal punch easily fits inside his own equal column. Use generous completely clear transparent gaps: no sprite pixel within the outer 15% of its column. No overlaps, cell lines, background, shadows or labels.
Canonical identity supplied in images1-3: same SLIM WIRY ginger-bearded man with TWO THIN LONG BRAIDS, white face paint, delicate red signal forehead arcs and red eyes, fine black facial circuitry, black MODEM cap, small red MODEM tee mark, open burgundy sleeveless vest, narrow black trousers, red sneakers, tattoos and small pendant. Narrow shoulders and slender arms, no bodybuilder anatomy. Rich hand-inked comic painting, clear silhouettes.
Every sprite strict side profile facing RIGHT, same body size and clothing. Cell1 idle. Cell2 walking with NEAR LEG forward and far leg behind, near arm swung back. Cell3 OPPOSITE walking with NEAR LEG behind and far leg forward, near arm swung forward. Cell4 one straight punch to right, compact stance, anatomically connected arm, other hand guards. Cell5 both fists up in compact guard. Cell6 knees tucked in a jump pose.
Coordinate plan: six column centers at 8.333%,25%,41.667%,58.333%,75%,91.667% of width. All sprites' LOWEST SHOE SOLE is positioned at 80% of canvas height, including cell6 jump: jump body is LOWER in its column, knees bent, lowest shoe touching that same invisible baseline. The game provides upward movement; do not place the jump in the air at a different baseline. Standing heads about30% of canvas height, with lots of blank alpha above. Maintain actual body scale while bend lowers head in punch/guard/jump.
Exactly six versions of the same character, plausible fists and joints, no extra body parts. No weapons or environment. No captions or numbers. Transparent pixels truly empty, not a drawn checkerboard.
